optimizer: new Adam, weights warmstart only; no optimizer resume
trial_order: NumPy default_rng(seed).permutation once per epoch; one trial at a time
state_policy: Carry hidden through every chronological chunk, detach at chunk boundaries, reset only between trials and epochs
loss: 1-squared normalized quaternion dot; movement and valid reference only; no labels or reference initialization in forward inputs
unscored_chunks: Forward all sensor timesteps, carry detached hidden, do not step optimizer
normalization: Retain initial checkpoint normalization, verify exact prepared manifest binding
validation: Full continuous trials 02/30 before training and after each full pass; equal-trial mean full-orientation RMSE in degrees
selection: Lowest validation score including epoch zero; preserve original weights if no improvement
test_use: None during training or checkpoint selection
